prompt: the frozen A3r0 prompt of G03-DEV-AMENDMENT-3-20261122.md section 1 (code constants SYSTEM and USER_TEMPLATE), unchanged
enable_rule: calibration_enabled may be set true only after an owner approval record exists for budget_envelope (P1-T01); execution_enabled only after the A3r1 freeze receipt (P1-T03). The shared budget ledger refuses E1R dispatch until the owner approval is recorded, whatever these flags say.
reservation_note: Per-attempt reservation = (UTF-8 bytes of the request body + 256 template tokens) x input price + max_tokens x output price, with the MAXIMUM endpoint price OpenRouter listed on 2026-11-22 (patent_to_pilot.budget.ledger.RESERVATION_PRICES) unless reservation_price is set here. Unknown price = no dispatch.

calibration.rule: h = sha256(salt + ':' + app_id); 8 cases with the longest built prompt in UTF-8 bytes (ties by h), then the 24 smallest h among the rest; same 32 cases for every model; input must be a TRAIN-only extract; no retrieval scoring

models.note: reasoning switch to be verified in TRAIN calibration (reasoning_tokens must be 0)

price/quota unverified: the ledger refuses dispatch (price_unknown) until a verified reservation_price is recorded here; without usage.cost the caller settles price x reported tokens (cost_source computed_from_reported_tokens); with neither, the attempt pauses as unknown cost

open_decisions: provider_routing: OpenRouter may route to any listed endpoint; worst-case DeepSeek V4 Flash endpoint price is about 10x the list price. Setting provider.max_price (or an explicit provider order) before the freeze would make the reservation bound and the realised cost tighter; not set here because it changes provider identity and must be declared before calibration.
